Composition-specific record for the Fe-free 5K2124 specimen. The stored lattice and coordinates are the official deposited 1.7 GPa, 293(2) K Pbnm refinement. Its idealized occupancies give Na4Al4Si4O16, whereas electron-microprobe analysis gives Na0.93Al1.02Si1.00O4 per nominal formula unit. The refinement therefore supplies a diffraction model for the measured specimen but does not claim crystallographic resolution of the small analytical non-stoichiometry. The EOS reference volume is the separately fitted zero-pressure conventional-cell volume.

Standard third-order Birch-Murnaghan pressure-volume EOS in the Eulerian finite-strain convention at room temperature. V0, K0, and K0\_prime were all fitted with EosFit7c; none was fixed. Parenthesized coefficient errors are retained as generic published uncertainties because the source gives neither confidence level nor covariance. The observed range is not a phase-stability guarantee. See docs/qin-2023-naalsio4-eos.md.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
